description: This file defines classes for a JSON-RPC client, service, and service manager, implementing WebSocket communication and RPC method handling.

classes.name: JsonRpcClient
classes.description: Handles WebSocket connection, sending requests, and processing incoming messages for JSON-RPC communication.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service with methods that can be registered and invoked via JSON-RPC.

classes.name: ServiceManager
classes.description: Manages multiple services, handles WebSocket connections, and coordinates RPC calls and responses.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens WebSocket connection for JsonRpcClient or ServiceManager.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request and returns a promise that resolves with the response.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a notification message via WebSocket.

methods.name: registerMethod
methods.description: Registers a method with a specific name and version in a Service.

methods.name: _callMethodByName
methods.description: Invokes a registered method by name with given parameters.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a new service with the ServiceManager.

methods.name: _connectService
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection for a specific service.

methods.name: _controllerActivateService
methods.description: Sends a request to activate a service via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: _sendResponse
methods.description: Sends a JSON response over WebSocket.

methods.name: _controllerCloneService
methods.description: Clones a service via JSON-RPC request.
